title: China-to-Jordan Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical and Mechanical Safety via Adopted IEC 62841
rows.target_requirement: Jordan demonstrates power-tool safety through JS standards that adopt the GSO / IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden motor-operated electric tools, accepted under the relevant JSMO technical regulation. The tool body and any charger, external power supply, or adapter must meet the adopted safety standard, and the conformity certificate must reflect the actual product configuration. Rated voltage and protective measures should suit the Jordan 230 V, 50 Hz supply.
target_standards: JS / GSO standards adopting IEC 62841 series （general and particular requirements）
Applicable JSMO technical regulation for electrical equipment safety
Charger / external power-supply safety standard where a separate supply is used [technical route]
rows.china_equivalent: China files often use the GB/T 3883 series for tool safety and separate charger standards where applicable. Because GB/T 3883 is itself an IEC 62841-aligned series, the technical content overlaps, but Jordan acceptance still depends on a JS-adopted standard reference and a JSMO conformity certificate rather than a China domestic report alone.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: GB/T 3883 and IEC 62841 are technically aligned, so the main gap is documentary and administrative: the report must be expressed against the JS-adopted IEC 62841 reference, cover the charger or external supply where used, and be wrapped in a JSMO conformity certificate. Rated-voltage marking should match the Jordan 230 V supply rather than China's 220/380 V.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: the applicable JSMO technical regulation and conformity certificate for in-scope electrical equipment. The JS-adopted IEC 62841 standard is the technical safety route used to support the certificate.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：适用电气设备的 JSMO 技术法规及符合性证书。JS 采用的 IEC 62841 标准是支持证书的技术安全路径。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：適用電氣設備的 JSMO 技術法規及符合性證書。JS 採用的 IEC 62841 標準是支援證書的技術安全路徑。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards where applicable, with CCC where required.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及适用的充电器专项标准，并在需要时附 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及適用的充電器專項標準，並在需要時附 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Likely technically aligned but not Jordan-ready until the GB/T 3883 evidence is restated against the JS-adopted IEC 62841 reference, covers the charger or external supply, carries 230 V supply marking, and is issued as a JSMO conformity certificate.

rows.requirement: Electromagnetic Compatibility and TRC Radio Approval
rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies must not cause excessive electromagnetic disturbance and need adequate immunity, demonstrated through JS standards that adopt the relevant GSO/IEC/EN EMC texts under JSMO. Cordless tools that include a wireless radio function, such as Bluetooth pairing or app connectivity, additionally require Telecommunications Regulatory Commission （TRC） type approval for the radio module before placement in Jordan.
target_standards: JS / GSO standards adopting IEC / CISPR / EN EMC texts under JSMO [technical route]
TRC type approval for radio modules in cordless / wireless tools
Applicable JSMO technical regulation covering EMC where in scope
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports, and SRRC type approval for radio modules domestically. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and the radio approval route still need Jordan-specific review, since SRRC does not substitute for TRC type approval.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is an EMC report that tests only the bare tool and omits the charger, battery pack, or electronic controller variants, plus reliance on China SRRC radio approval. For Jordan the EMC evidence must reflect the marketed configuration under the JS-adopted EMC standard, and any wireless module needs separate TRC type approval rather than the China SRRC certificate.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: JSMO EMC requirements via the adopted JS standard for in-scope apparatus, and TRC type approval for any radio module in cordless tools. The EMC standards themselves are the technical route; the TRC approval and JSMO regulation are the legal acts.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：适用设备须满足通过采用 JS 标准实现的 JSMO 电磁兼容要求，无绳工具的任何无线电模块须取得 TRC 型号核准。EMC 标准本身是技术路径；TRC 核准和 JSMO 法规是法律文件。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：適用設備須滿足通過採用 JS 標準實現的 JSMO 電磁相容要求，無繩工具的任何無線電模組須取得 TRC 型號核准。EMC 標準本身是技術路徑；TRC 核准和 JSMO 法規是法律文件。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence and SRRC radio approval, but Jordan acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, the JS-adopted standard, and TRC approval.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据和 SRRC 无线电核准，但约旦接受性取决于范围、限值、配置、JS 采用标准及 TRC 核准。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據和 SRRC 無線電核准，但約旦接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置、JS 採用標準及 TRC 核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Jordan-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system under the JS-adopted EMC standard and any wireless module holds TRC type approval; China SRRC approval does not substitute for TRC.

rows.requirement: Market Access Under JSMO Technical Regulation and Conformity Certificate
rows.target_requirement: Electric and cordless power tools placed on the Jordan market fall under the Jordan Standards and Metrology Organization （JSMO） system. Where a tool is covered by a mandatory JSMO technical regulation, importers need a conformity certificate demonstrating compliance with the applicable JS standard, which commonly adopts IEC, GSO, or EN texts. Goods typically enter through Aqaba and are subject to customs and JSMO conformity verification. The legal act is the JSMO regulation; the adopted standard is the technical route.
target_standards: JSMO mandatory technical regulations for in-scope electrical equipment / power tools
JSMO conformity certificate requirement for in-scope products
JS standards adopting GSO / IEC 62841 series [technical route]
Jordan customs procedures at Aqaba for imported goods
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, transportable tools, and lawn and garden machinery, with CCC where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence does not replace the Jordan conformity certificate, JSMO regulation mapping, or import conformity verification.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Jordan placement. The importer needs a JSMO conformity certificate mapped to the applicable JSMO technical regulation and adopted JS standard, plus customs documentation for Aqaba entry. Nominal supply is 230 V, 50 Hz, so the 50 Hz frequency matches China but rated voltage and marking should reflect the Jordan 230 V supply rather than China's 220/380 V.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for in-scope products: applicable JSMO technical regulation plus conformity certificate. The adopted JS / GSO / IEC 62841 standard is the technical route and is not itself the legal act.
target.zh: 适用产品的强制法律义务：适用 JSMO 技术法规加符合性证书。采用的 JS / GSO / IEC 62841 标准是技术路径，本身不是法律文件。
target.zht: 適用產品的強制法律義務：適用 JSMO 技術法規加符合性證書。採用的 JS / GSO / IEC 62841 標準是技術路徑，本身不是法律文件。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series for in-scope power tools, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常对适用电动工具采用 GB/T 3883 系列，并在适用时附 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常對適用電動工具採用 GB/T 3883 系列，並在適用時附 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Jordan-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence. A JSMO conformity certificate mapped to the applicable technical regulation and adopted JS standard, plus 230 V supply marking and Aqaba customs documentation, are required before placement.

rows.requirement: Noise — No EU-Style Outdoor Product Marking; Occupational Framework Only
rows.target_requirement: Honest finding: Jordan does not operate an equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise product-marking regime （Directive 2000/14/EC）, so there is generally no mandatory guaranteed-sound-power marking on power tools as a placement condition. Noise is addressed mainly through the Ministry of Labour occupational health and safety framework governing workplace noise exposure, not through a product-level conformity mark. Any noise figure a tool already declares is useful but is not a Jordan product-marking obligation. Exporters should still verify whether a specific JSMO regulation or tender references noise.
target_standards: Jordan Ministry of Labour occupational health and safety framework （workplace noise exposure）
No Jordan equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking [honest finding]
Project- or tender-specific noise requirements where separately stated [verify case by case]
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence usually focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may include declared noise emission values per the relevant GB/T 3883 noise test clauses. This declared-noise data carries over usefully because Jordan imposes no separate outdoor-noise product mark.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series （including declared noise emission clauses）
China domestic noise standards where applicable
rows.gap: There is no EU-style outdoor-noise marking gap to close for Jordan placement, because Jordan does not require it as a product-marking condition. The only realistic actions are: keep any existing declared noise values in the technical file, and confirm worker-exposure obligations fall under the Ministry of Labour framework at the deployment site rather than as an import-marking duty.

target.en: No mandatory Jordan product-level outdoor-noise marking obligation comparable to EU Directive 2000/14/EC. Workplace noise is a mandatory occupational duty under the Ministry of Labour framework but applies to the user/employer, not as a product placement mark.
target.zh: 约旦不存在与欧盟指令 2000/14/EC 相当的强制产品层面户外噪声标识义务。工作场所噪声是劳动部框架下的强制职业义务，但适用于使用者/雇主，而非作为产品投放标识。
target.zht: 約旦不存在與歐盟指令 2000/14/EC 相當的強制產品層面戶外噪聲標識義務。工作場所噪聲是勞動部框架下的強制職業義務，但適用於使用者/雇主，而非作為產品投放標識。

cn.en: China GB/T 3883 may include declared noise values, but these are technical declarations rather than a separate mandatory product-marking regime.
cn.zh: 中国 GB/T 3883 可包含声明噪声值，但属于技术声明，而非独立的强制产品标识制度。
cn.zht: 中國 GB/T 3883 可包含聲明噪聲值，但屬於技術聲明，而非獨立的強制產品標識制度。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style outdoor-noise product-marking barrier for Jordan placement; noise is handled honestly as an occupational matter under the Ministry of Labour framework. Retain any declared noise values and verify only project- or tender-specific noise clauses case by case.

rows.target_requirement: Jordan does not operate an EU-style standalone RoHS directive as a universal power-tool placement condition. Restricted-substance and material expectations are generally addressed through adopted JS / GSO standards referenced in the JSMO technical regulation and through general consumer-protection and environmental rules. Honest finding: substance documentation that already meets China RoHS or IEC-aligned material declarations usually carries over, but exporters should confirm whether a specific JSMO regulation or GSO technical regulation cites substance limits for the product class.
target_standards: JS / GSO standards referenced by the applicable JSMO technical regulation
Jordan consumer-protection and environmental rules where applicable
No EU-style standalone RoHS directive as a universal placement condition [honest finding]
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS （管理办法 / GB/T 26572 limits） and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review. Because Jordan has no separate mandatory RoHS mark for power tools, this China material documentation is generally a usable basis, subject to any GSO-specific substance clause.
rows.gap: The gap is narrower than for the EU: there is usually no separate mandatory RoHS conformity file required for Jordan placement. The realistic action is to keep China RoHS / material declarations in the technical file and verify whether the specific JSMO or GSO technical regulation for the product class adds any substance limit, labelling, or environmental clause.

target.en: No universal EU-style standalone RoHS placement obligation for Jordan. Substance expectations come via the adopted JS / GSO standard cited in the applicable JSMO technical regulation, plus general consumer-protection and environmental rules.
target.zh: 约旦不存在欧盟式独立 RoHS 的普遍投放义务。物质要求来自适用 JSMO 技术法规引用的 JS / GSO 采用标准，以及一般消费者保护和环境规则。
target.zht: 約旦不存在歐盟式獨立 RoHS 的普遍投放義務。物質要求來自適用 JSMO 技術法規引用的 JS / GSO 採用標準，以及一般消費者保護和環境規則。

cn.en: Mandatory China baseline may include China RoHS （GB/T 26572） marking and GB/T 3883 safety where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国强制基线在适用时可包含中国 RoHS（GB/T 26572）标识及 GB/T 3883 安全。
cn.zht: 中國強制基線在適用時可包含中國 RoHS（GB/T 26572）標識及 GB/T 3883 安全。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Generally low-barrier for Jordan: existing China RoHS / material declarations usually carry over since there is no EU-style standalone RoHS mark. Confirm only whether the specific JSMO / GSO technical regulation for the product class adds substance or labelling clauses.

rows.target_requirement: Honest finding: Jordan does not operate an equivalent of the EU Battery Regulation （EU） 2023/1542 with its economic-operator, battery passport, and removability duties as a placement condition. Cordless-tool battery packs are addressed mainly through adopted JS / GSO / IEC battery safety standards referenced in the JSMO conformity certificate and through lithium-battery transport safety rules at Aqaba. There is no separate mandatory EU-style battery CE mark, but the pack must still meet the adopted safety standard and transport requirements.
target_standards: JS / GSO / IEC adopted battery safety standard referenced by the JSMO conformity certificate
Lithium-battery transport safety rules （UN 38.3 / IATA / IMDG） for Aqaba entry
No EU-style Battery Regulation （EU） 2023/1542 placement regime in Jordan [honest finding]
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, plus separate lithium-battery safety and UN 38.3 transport evidence. Because Jordan has no EU-style battery placement regime, this China battery-safety and transport evidence is generally a usable basis when wrapped into the JSMO conformity certificate.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and UN 38.3 transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: The gap is narrower than for the EU: there is no EU-style battery economic-operator, passport, or removability obligation to satisfy for Jordan. The realistic action is to ensure the pack meets the adopted JS / GSO / IEC battery safety standard cited in the conformity certificate and holds valid UN 38.3 / transport documentation for Aqaba entry.

target.en: No EU-style mandatory battery placement regime in Jordan. Mandatory elements are the adopted JS / GSO / IEC battery safety standard via the JSMO conformity certificate and lithium-battery transport safety for import.
target.zh: 约旦不存在欧盟式强制电池投放体系。强制要素是通过 JSMO 符合性证书实现的 JS / GSO / IEC 电池安全采用标准，以及进口的锂电池运输安全。
target.zht: 約旦不存在歐盟式強制電池投放體系。強制要素是通過 JSMO 符合性證書實現的 JS / GSO / IEC 電池安全採用標準，以及進口的鋰電池運輸安全。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence commonly uses GB/T 3883 plus lithium-battery safety and UN 38.3 transport tests where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据通常采用 GB/T 3883，并在适用时附锂电池安全和 UN 38.3 运输测试。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據通常採用 GB/T 3883，並在適用時附鋰電池安全和 UN 38.3 運輸測試。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Generally lower-barrier than the EU for cordless tools: no EU-style battery placement regime applies. Ensure the pack meets the adopted JS / GSO / IEC battery safety standard in the JSMO conformity certificate and holds valid UN 38.3 / transport documentation for Aqaba.
